sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 offers an excellent family of models across a wide range of sizes, from 0.8B to 397B parameters. In practice, this means there is nearly a model for every budget. Given such a broad lineup that can fit almost any hardware configuration, the value of model compression through quantization may seem questionable.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 & Qwen3.6 Usage Guide Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 are multimodal mixture-of-experts models featuring a gated delta networks architecture. This guide covers how to efficiently deploy and serve both models using vLLM.
